newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco injects 668 million dirhams at auction.
newsitem.headline: Morocco injects 668 million dirhams at auction.

text.p: Morocco's Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) injected 668 million dirhams in the money market for one week at its repurchase auction, a bank official said on Thursday.

The bank received bids totalling 5.060 billion dirhams and allocated 3.168 billion dirhams at 6.5 percent interest rate. That was more than the 2.500 billion dirhams leaving the market this week, the official said.
It satisfied 62.61 percent of the demand for liquidity.
The next auction is due on November 20, 1996, the bank said.
